About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
Manage official community channels, including social media platforms, discord, and community groups.
 
Plan and execute community engagement activities such as online events, contests, and campaigns.
 
Actively engage with players, respond to inquiries, and foster a positive and inclusive community environment.
 
Monitor community sentiment and gather player feedback, sharing insights with internal stakeholders.
 
Support marketing, PR, and influencer initiatives by amplifying announcements and campaigns within the community.
 
Manage KOC incubation programs, identify and onboard emerging creators and community members on multiple social media platforms.
 
Build and lead content moderator teams to enforce community guidelines to ensure safe and respectful interactions.
 
Host community surveys and market user research to support cross-functional team campaigns and align with user preferences and relevance.

Who We Look For
At least 3 years of experience in community management, social media, or related roles.
 
Strong understanding of gaming communities and player behavior in Thailand.
 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Thai and English.
 
Experience managing social media platforms and community tools.
 
Passion for mobile and PC gaming, with live-service experience preferred.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Thailand
